Test Steps: 1. Open the app on a phone. 2. Sign in with an agent's number and code. 3. Note which screen opens.
Test Data: Agent account; the test login code from the dev team
Expected Result: The agent app opens on its own home screen. The customer app is never shown, not even for a moment.

Element / Feature: Agent stays in the agent app
Test Steps: 1. Signed in as an agent, type the customer home address into the browser. 2. Then type the ops console address.
Expected Result: Both attempts return the agent to their own app. Neither the customer app nor the ops console opens.

Test Steps: 1. Sign out from the profile. 2. Sign in again as the same agent. 3. Check My jobs.
Test Data: Agent holding at least one job
Expected Result: The jobs already accepted are still there after signing back in. Nothing is lost by signing out.

Test Steps: 1. Tap Home, New, My jobs and Money in turn. 2. Use the back gesture after each.
Expected Result: Each tab opens its own screen and is highlighted while active. Back returns to the previous screen without a blank page.

Element / Feature: Counts on the New and My jobs tabs
Test Steps: 1. Note the number on the New tab. 2. Open it and count the jobs. 3. Do the same for My jobs. 4. Accept a job and check both numbers again.
Test Data: At least two free jobs and one accepted job
Expected Result: Each number matches the jobs on that screen, and both update after a job is accepted — New goes down by one, My jobs up by one.

Test Steps: 1. From the home screen tap the person icon in the top bar.
Expected Result: The profile opens. It is reached from the top bar because the bottom bar is full at four tabs.

Test Steps: 1. Work a full pickup holding the phone in one hand, outside in bright daylight.
Test Data: Phone at 390 x 844, screen at full brightness
Expected Result: Every control needed is reachable with a thumb, the text stays readable in daylight, and no step needs two hands or a pinch to zoom.

Test Steps: 1. Accept a job, start it, collect payment and complete a handover. 2. Watch for any card sliding over the top of the screen.
Test Data: A full pickup worked end to end
Expected Result: No toast or pop-up ever covers the screen. Every confirmation appears on the card or field the agent is already looking at.

Test Steps: 1. Set the network to Slow 3G. 2. Load the home screen and accept a job. 3. Set it to offline and try an action. 4. Restore the network.
Expected Result: Slow actions show they are working rather than sitting still. Offline says the connection is the problem, and the app recovers by itself once signal returns.

Test Steps: 1. Turn the phone to landscape on the home screen, a job screen and the money screen.
Expected Result: Each screen stays usable with nothing cut off or overlapping.

Element / Feature: New jobs appear on their own
Test Steps: 1. Sign in as an agent and stay on the home screen. 2. Have a customer book a pickup in that area. 3. Watch the screen without touching it.
Expected Result: The new job appears within a reasonable time with no pull-to-refresh and no reopening the app.

Test Steps: 1. Arrange several free jobs across different areas and dates. 2. Open New. 3. Compare the list against what ops shows as unassigned.
Expected Result: Every unassigned job is visible to the agent. None is silently hidden.

Element / Feature: Jobs dated ahead sit under Later
Test Steps: 1. Arrange one free job for today and one for three days ahead. 2. Open New.
Test Data: One job today, one dated three days ahead
Expected Result: Both are listed. The future one appears under a Later heading rather than being mixed in with today's or hidden.

Element / Feature: What a job card shows before accepting
Test Steps: 1. Read one free job card in full without opening it.
Expected Result: The card gives the area, the date, the parcel and the amount to collect if any — enough to decide whether to take it without opening it.

Test Steps: 1. Open New when every job has been taken.
Expected Result: An empty state says there is no work waiting. Not a blank screen or a spinner that never stops.

Test Steps: 1. Accept a free job. 2. Open My jobs. 3. Check the customer's own order screen.
Expected Result: The job moves out of New into My jobs, and the customer's order shows that an agent has accepted it.

Element / Feature: Two agents taking the same job
Test Steps: 1. Open the same free job on two agent phones. 2. Press Accept on both at the same moment. 3. Check both phones and the ops board.
Expected Result: Only one agent gets it. The other is told plainly that it has been taken, and the job shows one agent on the ops board, never two.

Element / Feature: A job assigned by ops while the agent is looking
Test Steps: 1. Keep New open. 2. Have ops assign one of the listed jobs to a different agent. 3. Try to accept it.
Test Data: One free job assigned by ops mid-view
Expected Result: The job either disappears or refuses the accept with a clear message. The agent is never left believing they hold a job they do not.

Test Steps: 1. Accept two jobs. 2. Open My jobs. 3. Read both cards.
Test Data: Two accepted jobs at different stages
Expected Result: Both are listed with their current stage, and the next thing to do on each is obvious from the card.

Test Steps: 1. Open an accepted job. 2. Read every part of the screen.
Expected Result: The pickup address, the customer's name and number, the parcel details and the amount to collect are all there, with no blank fields.

Element / Feature: Calling and navigating to the customer
Test Steps: 1. Tap the customer's phone number. 2. Go back and tap the address.
Test Data: A job with a phone number and address
Expected Result: The number opens the phone dialler with the digits already filled. The address opens maps or is at least selectable to copy.

Test Steps: 1. Open an accepted job. 2. Press Start pickup. 3. Check the customer's order.
Test Data: A job in the accepted stage
Expected Result: The job moves to out for pickup and the customer's order shows the agent is on the way.

Element / Feature: Only the right actions are offered
Test Steps: 1. Open jobs at the accepted, out-for-pickup and picked-up stages in turn. 2. Note which buttons each offers.
Test Data: One job at each of the three stages
Expected Result: Each screen offers only what makes sense at that stage. Nothing lets the agent skip a step or go backwards.

Element / Feature: Mark picked up with the handover code
Test Steps: 1. Ask the customer for the code on their order. 2. Enter a wrong code. 3. Enter the correct one.
Test Data: The customer's handover code; wrong code 0000
Expected Result: The wrong code is refused with the message right under the field being retyped. The correct code marks the parcel picked up.

Element / Feature: The code is not shown to the agent
Test Steps: 1. Look everywhere on the job screen for the handover code before asking the customer.
Expected Result: The code appears nowhere in the agent's app. The agent has to get it from the customer, which is the whole point of it.

Test Steps: 1. Enter a wrong code several times in a row. 2. Read what the screen says. 3. Then enter the correct one.
Expected Result: The screen states what is happening — the attempts left, or that the code is now locked — and says what to do next. It does not fail silently or let unlimited guessing through.

Element / Feature: Customer's phone is dead at the door
Test Steps: 1. On a job awaiting handover, with the customer unable to give a code, look for a way forward.
Test Data: A job where no code can be produced
Expected Result: The agent is told to call the office rather than being left stuck, and cannot complete the handover without the code themselves.

Test Steps: 1. Open a job with an amount owed. 2. Press Collect payment. 3. Read the sheet before touching anything.
Expected Result: The sheet asks two things — cash or UPI, and how much — with no payment method pre-selected, so it cannot be tapped through without reading.

Test Steps: 1. Choose Cash. 2. Confirm the amount. 3. Complete the collection. 4. Open the Money screen.
Expected Result: The collection is recorded and the amount appears on the Money screen as cash in the bag.

Test Steps: 1. Choose UPI. 2. Confirm the amount. 3. Complete the collection. 4. Open the Money screen.
Expected Result: The collection is recorded, but it does not add to the cash-in-bag figure — only cash is physically in the agent's bag.

Test Steps: 1. Open the collect sheet. 2. Enter the amount but choose neither cash nor UPI. 3. Try to confirm.
Expected Result: The sheet refuses and points at the missing choice. Nothing is recorded.

Element / Feature: Collecting a different amount than owed
Test Steps: 1. Open the collect sheet on a job owing a known amount. 2. Enter a smaller amount and confirm. 3. Then try a zero and a negative amount.
Expected Result: A part payment is either accepted and shown as short, or refused with a reason. Zero and negative are refused outright.

Test Steps: 1. Open a job that still owes money. 2. Look at the action bar at the bottom.
Expected Result: Collect payment sits on its own with the amount in its label, separated from the other actions, so it cannot be missed on the way to Mark picked up.

Element / Feature: Marking picked up while money is still owed
Test Steps: 1. Open a job that owes money without collecting. 2. Try to mark it picked up.
Expected Result: The agent is stopped or clearly warned that money is still owed. An agent must not be able to walk away from the door having lost the payment.

Test Steps: 1. Collect cash on two jobs. 2. Open Money. 3. Read the top figure and the line under it.
Expected Result: The cash figure reads 2000, large and unmistakable, with one line saying to give it to the hub today.

Test Steps: 1. Open Money after several collections. 2. Read each row.
Test Data: Three or four collections across the morning
Expected Result: Each row shows the order number and the time the money changed hands, which is what anyone asks about on the phone.

Element / Feature: The day rolls over at midnight
Test Steps: 1. Note the Money total at the end of a working day. 2. Open the screen again after midnight India time.
Expected Result: The new day starts at zero and yesterday's takings are no longer counted as today's.

Test Steps: 1. Open Money at the start of a shift before collecting anything.
Expected Result: The screen reads zero with an explanation, rather than showing a blank area or an error.

Test Steps: 1. Open the profile after several collections. 2. Compare cash in your bag and money taken today against the Money screen.
Test Data: Two cash collections and one UPI collection
Expected Result: Both figures agree with the Money screen, and tapping either opens it. The UPI collection counts in the number taken but not in the cash figure.

Test Steps: 1. Take a picked-up parcel to the hub. 2. Open the job. 3. Complete the hub handover with the code from the hub staff.
Test Data: A picked-up parcel and the hub's code
Expected Result: The parcel is recorded as received at the hub and leaves the agent's active list.

Test Steps: 1. Enter a wrong code at the hub handover. 2. Then the correct one.
Test Data: Wrong code 0000; then the hub's real code
Expected Result: The wrong code is refused inline and the correct one completes the handover, exactly as at the customer's door.

Element / Feature: A finished job leaves the list
Test Steps: 1. Complete a hub handover. 2. Open My jobs.
Test Data: One job just handed over at the hub
Expected Result: The finished job is no longer in the active list, and the tab count has dropped by one.

Test Steps: 1. Open the profile. 2. Check the name and phone number.
Expected Result: The details match the agent's own record. No blank fields and no placeholder text.

Test Steps: 1. Open the profile. 2. Tap Call the office.
Expected Result: The dialler opens with the office number already filled in.

Test Steps: 1. Have ops deactivate the agent while they hold a job. 2. Have the agent use the app.
Test Data: An agent holding one job, deactivated by ops
Expected Result: The agent is told clearly what has happened and what to do about the job in hand. They are not left silently unable to act with a parcel in the van.
